name: [x] Divinity
comment: Divinity: Original Sin Enhanced Edition, controller UI (Larian's in-game Controller Layout screen): LS move (press: selector mode), RS rotate/zoom camera (press: toggle tooltips), A default action/accept, B cancel (hold: end turn), X action menu, Y toggle hot bar, LB/RB previous/next item or enemy, LT hold party selection, RT hold panel selection, D-pad right attack mode / left force splitscreen / up tactical view / down toggle sneak, Back map, Start game menu. Both triggers sit on the right thumb: their radials are held while the left wheel picks, which one thumb cannot do. The camera is a plain RSVPAD swipe zone (no gyro, turn-based game). Push-to-talk, the gyro look zone, the bumper-radial folder with its LB/RB stick pads removed.
